blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–Badminton world number one An Se-young had stern words for her watching father as her frustrations threatened to boil over in victory at the Asian Games 2026 in Japan on Wednesday. The reigning world and Olympic champion from South Korea defeated home player Akane Yamaguchi in three tough games in the semi-finals of the women’s team event in Nagoya. But the 24-year-old was not always at her brilliant best against the world number three, winning 21-9, 18-21, 21-11. “I think I expressed it too forcefully, to make myself notice […]...
